errors.evidence: The description highlights a specific drop in 2009 compared to 2008. While the prompt allows for noting sequential changes, it also cautions against making comparisons. Singling out this specific year-over-year change and framing it as something that "stands out" borders on interpretation rather than a purely objective description of all data points.
